_what: Rule 4b applied to the readings of every record of rounds 5 to 8 (decision of the Claude analysis session, 24 October 2026; rules.md, rule 4b). Rule 4b: where rule 1's control does not tie, a record leaves the primary when (i) both readings report that the year t table prints, for an underwriting year u <= t-2, cumulative paid lower than the year t-1 report printed for the same year, by more than the exchange rate explains and with no explanation in either filing; (ii) the year t table fails the year's accounts by more than 10% (rule 1's test); and (iii) no base gives a figure that reconciles (rule 3 fails).
_method: scan_rule_4b.py lists every passage in every reading (round5/readings/*.json, round8/readings/Z7.json, Z8.json) that puts paid or payments near a word of decrease, in two passes (narrow and loose). 36 of the 83 records have such a passage; each was read against the precondition and conditions (i) to (iii), and the answers are under 'read'. The other 47 records have no reading that reports a cumulative paid figure falling, so condition (i) ('both readings report') fails for them by its wording. Three of them, 2488/2016, 382/2021 and 1967/2017, which review 8 named with 2232/2017 and 1729/2023 as records rule 1 does not reach, are answered under 'read' too (39 records in all); the other 44 are under 'no_fall_reported'.
